sections.heading: D — Accuracy and Verification
sections.markdown:
## D — Accuracy and Verification, Section Thirteen Violations and Penalties

Section D records the accuracy posture for the Section Thirteen violation and penalty rules. Every knowledge fact is required to trace to its cited handbook page, with the cited page stating the fact in full. Confidence is high across the section because every rule comes from the single pinned handbook edition. The sample-license graphic fields are illustration, so no value is asserted from them, and mailing and website contact details are omitted as non-testable. The point table and insurance figures are preserved in words with the insurance repeat cited to its own page here. Handbook wording is paraphrased throughout; no official sentence, table, or question is reproduced. No time-variable or location-variable fact appears beyond the pinned edition, so nothing required isolation as dynamic knowledge.
